authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.56: STYLE R2004+ missing-xdictionary flag; STYLE xref-block handle is a hard pointer.
scope: When the writer synthesizes STANDARD STYLE and no caller/source STANDARD is supplied, mark its nonexistent xdictionary missing and explicitly encode its null xref as hard pointer for AC1018+. Preserve caller-supplied missing flags and untyped or explicitly typed null xref, and retain AC1015 behavior.
physical_evidence: LibreDWG 0.14 independently decodes ODA-produced AC1018, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 STANDARD STYLE with xdictionary-missing=1 and xref=(5,0,0). Generated production AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 now read the same flags and role, preserving a following LINE. AC1015 retains its old untyped null and has no xdictionary-missing flag.
